text:
people-ops: Heads-up 10 We put together a super-compact 'impact card' pack for goal/check-in notes. Each card = 1-line impact, 1 evidence line, 1 ask/support or next step. Target: make calibration notes + 1:1 prep <30s to read. Drop quick thoughts? cc @sam.w @priya

people-ops: Example cards (feel free to copy/paste):

people-ops: ```
Impact: Reduced model inference cost by ~18% across batch jobs.
Evidence: Implemented KV cache + quantized weights; avg cost/token down 0.18 -> 0.15.
Ask: Help prioritize 0.2 FTE from infra to harden rollout.
```

sam.w: Love the brevity. Could we add a one-word "confidence" tag at the end (high/med/low)? Helps calibration readers quickly gauge signal quality.

people-ops: Yep, adding optional tag. Maybe like: `... Ask: ... | confidence: med`.

priya: For upward feedback (IC -> manager) swap "Ask" to "Support needed" so it's manager-actionable. Also propose a variant for self-review (frame impact as "I drove...").

jules: Add a stretch-goal microcard too:

jules: ```
Stretch: Lead cross-team infra metric to hit P95 <200ms.
Why: API adoption increased P95 in Q2.
Support: 0.4 FTE from eng-infra for 6w. | confidence: med
```

lina: Can we include a single-line Slack paste format for quick standups? e.g. `Impact — Evidence — Ask` compressed. That'd be useful for skip-level threads.

people-ops: Yep, we'll ship the compressed line and add three role-specific starter cards (eng, product, customer ops). Also will include a tiny example bank with sentence fragments people can remix.

emily.p: Logistics q: who owns updates to this pack? people-ops or manager-tooling repo?

people-ops: people-ops will be canonical owner. Manager-tooling can PR formatting/export helpers. We'll tag versions like `v2024-07-15`.

sam.w: Tiny UX thought: include a checkbox list for reviewers: [ ] Evidence credible [ ] Impact believable [ ] Actionable ask. Quick ticks during calibration would speed meetings.

people-ops: Nice. We'll add reviewer checkboxes and a one-click "copy Slack line" CTA on the doc page.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Handbook page "Impact cards: micro-templates" scheduled to publish 2024-07-15. Announcement to #announcements on publish. :bell:

priya: Happy to pilot with my team next week and feed examples back.

jules: I'll drop 4 real examples from our last calibration to seed the bank.

people-ops: Thanks everyone! Will update the doc by EOD and ping for final thumbs. :sparkles:
